input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: First preflight failed on sync_tree_counts (new usage.mjs opt-out switch) and on the siblings orphan budget (new page had no inbound sibling link); fixed by running sync_tree_counts.py and linking from isolation-forest and wasserstein-distance.

doc_friction.issue: The definition of done says to run venture-preflight, but not that a new page must get an inbound link from a sibling or the siblings orphan budget (0) goes red; 'a link from a sibling tool' is listed, but only as something preflight catches.
Says nothing about the AEP extract stamping readings by hour ending (00:00 is hour ending 24 of the day before). Laying it out as clock hours put each day's last hour on the wrong row.

deviations.why: The paper's rho=1.5 passed the residual test before the split had settled (0.04 from TensorLy on a 60x40 case, certified gap 2.6% on the example).
deviations.did: Used rho=1.05 and report a duality gap with every result.
deviations.result: Agrees with TensorLy to 1e-9 on the test case; gap under 0.01% on the example, about 2x the iterations.

notes: Explore idea: robust PCA by principal component pursuit (Candes et al. 2011), from the research-tools candidate list, as a new tool ventures/robust-pca: inexact ALM, Jacobi SVD, PCP with missing entries, and a duality certificate. Verified against the paper's Sec 4.1 exact-recovery experiment and TensorLy 0.10.0 (eval/reference.py). Local checks: node --test 41/41; run_venture_tests robust-pca isolation-forest wasserstein-distance all ok; venture-preflight robust-pca clean (build + check.mjs). Example: AEP 2017 day x hour. The spring DST day ranks 2nd; holidays rank low (whole-row shifts are low rank). The tool caught the hour-ending convention in its own example.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a numerical-methods engineer implementing PCP+ALM+Jacobi SVD, reference comparison, page, CLI and docs

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
